# Metabolic Bridge drawing-set corpus

This is the Builder-visible, non-oracle test package for a compact coordination exercise. Only files in this directory may be supplied to the system under test. Ground truth and expected classifications are stored separately under `../oracle/` and must not be ingested.

The package is intentionally small: one three-sheet vector PDF, one door schedule, and one door specification excerpt. Drawing coordinates and labels are ordinary project information; no answer key or test marker is embedded in these files.
